labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Sealskin is a self-hosted browser isolation and remote application streaming platform.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Sealskin

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG SEALSKIN_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"
ENV HOME=/config

# install software
RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --upgrade --virtual=build-dependencies \
    python3-dev \
    py3-pip && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    caddy \
    openssl \
    python3 && \
  echo "**** install sealskin ****" && \
  if [ -z ${SEALSKIN_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    SEALSKIN_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/selkies-project/sealskin/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    "/tmp/sealskin_server-${SEALSKIN_VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl" -L \
    "https://github.com/selkies-project/sealskin/releases/download/${SEALSKIN_VERSION}/sealskin_server-${SEALSKIN_VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl" && \
  pip3 install \
    "/tmp/sealskin_server-${SEALSKIN_VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl" --break-system-packages && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    $HOME/.cache \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8000 8443
VOLUME /config /storage

units.name: init-sealskin
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

mkdir -p /config/ssl

# create self signed cert
if [ ! -f "/config/ssl/proxy_key.pem" ]; then
  openssl req -new -x509 \
    -days 3650 -nodes \
    -out /config/ssl/proxy_cert.pem \
    -keyout /config/ssl/proxy_key.pem \
    -subj "/C=US/ST=CA/L=Carlsbad/O=Linuxserver.io/OU=LSIO Server/CN=*"
  chmod 600 /config/ssl/proxy_key.pem
fi

# generate server key
if [ ! -f "/config/ssl/server_key.pem" ]; then
  openssl genpkey \
    -algorithm RSA \
    -out /config/ssl/server_key.pem \
    -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096
  chmod 600 /config/ssl/server_key.pem
fi

# docker socket perms
DOCKER_SOCK_PATH="/var/run/docker.sock"
if [ -S "${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}" ]; then
  DOCKER_GID=$(stat -c '%g' "${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}")
  if ! id -G abc | grep -qw "${DOCKER_GID}"; then
    DOCKER_GROUP_NAME=$(getent group "${DOCKER_GID}" | awk -F: '{print $1}')
    if [ -z "${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}" ]; then
      DOCKER_GROUP_NAME="docker_sock_group"
      echo "**** Creating group '${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}' with GID ${DOCKER_GID} for the Docker socket ****"
      groupadd -g "${DOCKER_GID}" "${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}"
    fi
    echo "**** Adding user 'abc' to group '${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}' (GID: ${DOCKER_GID}) ****"
    usermod -a -G "${DOCKER_GROUP_NAME}" abc
  fi
  if [ "$(stat -c '%A' "${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}" | cut -c 5,6)" != "rw" ]; then
    echo -e "\n**** WARNING: The Docker socket ${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH} does not have group read/write permissions. ****"
    echo "**** To fix this, run the following command on your DOCKER HOST: ****"
    echo -e "sudo chmod g+rw ${DOCKER_SOCK_PATH}\n"
  fi
fi

# perms
lsiown abc:abc /storage
lsiown -R abc:abc /config

units.name: svc-sealskin
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# Run SealSkin
exec s6-setuidgid abc \
  sealskin-server

notes.upstream:
# SealSkin 0.4.1

Maintenance release.

## Changes

* **Collaboration rooms on LinuxServer.io images.** A room's viewers reach
  the container on the session's own login again, not a view-only login of
  their own. The view-only login broke collaboration in LinuxServer.io
  images, and it held nothing back: every collaboration session already caps
  each participant through its Selkies token.
* **Kubernetes pull secrets.** The server reads a session template's pull
  secrets on the first call, however recently the host booted.
